description: This file defines an extension method for MembershipEntry objects to determine if the IAmAlive message has been missed, based on cluster options and a timestamp.

classes.name: MembershipTableEntryExtensions
classes.description: A static class that provides extension methods for MembershipEntry objects, specifically for checking if IAmAlive messages have been missed.

methods.name: HasMissedIAmAlives
methods.description: An extension method to determine whether the effective IAmAlive time of a membership entry has been missed by comparing it with the current time and allowed miss period.
